items.prompt: One-share entry 1000 plus fee 2 and exit 1100 minus fee 2. Under initial-outlay denominator, what is net return?

options.why: Net gain 96 divided by the complete initial outlay 1002.
That is the gross price return, not stated net return.
Final sale price is not the stated denominator.
